finalText: Verification passes. Migrated the remaining 12 app files (`analytics/cohort`, `orders/returnService`, `orders/shipment`, `billing/refund`, `billing/couponService`, `support/macroAdmin`, `support/sla`, `catalog/variantAdmin`, `catalog/supplier`, `accounts/teamService`, `accounts/apiKeyAdmin`, `accounts/session`) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, leaving `cache.query` and the vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched as required.
